item.title: Professor honoured for groundbreaking work transforming simulation education
item.description: Swansea University’s Joanne Davies has been celebrated for her exceptional achievement in the field medical training at this year’s prestigious St David Awards.

item.title: ReNeuron establishes new base at Swansea University’s Institute of Life Science in major research partnership
item.description: ReNeuron Group Limited, a leading UK biotechnology company, has joined Swansea University’s Institute of Life Science (ILS) in a new strategic research partnership to advance next-generation exosome therapies, helping transport medicines to the parts of the body where they are needed most.

item.title: National Cardiovascular Research Network lands transformative grant to tackle heart disease
item.description: A new interdisciplinary network of leading clinicians, researchers, patients and innovators has secured landmark funding that will transform efforts to prevent, diagnose and treat heart disease across Wales.

item.title: Swansea University to support Argentine creative entrepreneurs through international bootcamp
item.description: Swansea University’s School of Management has partnered with UK-based consultancy Libra Europe to deliver the 2026 Diseño Argentino Exponencial — Creative Bootcamp, an international entrepreneurship programme supporting emerging entrepreneurs across Argentina’s design and creative sectors.

item.title: Swansea University part of major £65.6 million UKRI investment to train next generation of nuclear engineers and scientists
item.description: Swansea University will play a key role in a new £65.6 million UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) Doctoral Focal Award in Nuclear Skills, helping to train specialists essential to future clean energy, national security and advanced nuclear technologies.

item.title: World’s largest prize for young writers: Swansea University Dylan Thomas Prize 2026
item.description: The shortlist for the world’s largest and most prestigious literary prize for young writers – the Swansea University Dylan Thomas Prize – is announced today featuring six extraordinary, emerging voices, whose writing explores love and beauty, society and gender – with a distinct focus on coming-of-age stories.

item.title: Swansea University graduates win top UK awards for transforming lives across India and Ghana
item.description: Two Swansea University graduates have been honoured in the British Council’s Study UK Alumni Awards 2026, receiving national recognition in India and Ghana for their leadership and contributions to social impact, culture, and creativity.

item.title: New report sounds alarm on AI chatbots driving violence against women and girls
item.description: A new report provides the first comprehensive analysis of how AI chatbots are reshaping violence against women and girls (VAWG) in dangerous new ways.

item.title: Study finds dust-resilient perovskite solar cells could cut manufacturing costs and expand green energy worldwide
item.description: New research has shown that perovskite solar cells (PSCs) are remarkably resilient to dust during production, challenging the industry belief that high-performance solar technology must be manufactured in sterile and expensive "cleanrooms”.

item.title: Leading poets share their work to help inspire future students
item.description: A-level English students were given a unique insight into the work of two the UK’s most acclaimed poets at a special Swansea University event.
